lead: Mukhtar Ansari was an Indian politician, born on 30 June 1963 in Ghazipur district.
He died on 28 March 2024 in Banda district at the age of 60.
He has held the office of Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
This profile collects the Mukhtar facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
